source_title: 내가 징기로 골드 버는 법 공유함
subtitle: 사람 마음을 팔아 10골드 버는 징기

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
아무도 안 드시면 제가
힐 템으로 먹어도 될까요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter medium shot inside a dungeon stone floor, cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Undead Paladin (she/her) with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped onto her back puts on a sweet innocent smile and points politely toward a glowing caster staff resting beside an open wooden boss chest. On the right, Orc Warrior (she/her) holding her compact one-handed axe and sturdy shield nods kindly without suspicion.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
이미 있으신 부위 같던데
탱 연습용으로 주실래요 ㅠ
cuts.visual_prompt: Angled over-the-shoulder shot in a dungeon room, cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Undead Paladin (she/her) with her two-handed warhammer strapped onto her back hides a small parchment loot-comparison scroll behind her back with one hand while pressing her other hand to her chest with fake watery puppy-dog eyes, eyeing a shiny plate tank armor drop. On the right, Orc Warrior (she/her) with her weapon tucked at her waist cheerfully gives a big naive thumbs-up.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
던전 한 판에 10골드!
거절 못 하게 묻는 게 핵심~
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-angle medium shot at a wooden merchant stall, cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left behind the counter, a cute 2.5-head chibi SD goblin vendor NPC inspects the caster staff and heavy plate tank armor just dumped onto the stall. On the right, Undead Paladin (she/her) with her two-handed warhammer strapped on her back smirks smugly while hugging a bulging tied brown leather pouch overflowing with round gold coins.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80% of the frame height, cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Orc Warrior (she/her) freezes with pale face, wide teary betrayed eyes, jaw dropped in disbelief, and tiny shattered heart icons overhead. On the right, Gnome Rogue (she/her) stares in horrified outrage with bulging eyes, gritted teeth, and vertical shock lines as both witness the vendor sale off-panel.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
팔 거면서 불쌍한 척했냐?!
난 40 탈것비도 아끼는데!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle confrontation shot on stone pavement, cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Gnome Rogue (she/her) with her daggers sheathed at her waist leaps forward furiously, pointing an accusing finger at the gold pouch. On the right, Undead Paladin (she/her) with her two-handed warhammer strapped on her back nonchalantly holds the tied leather gold pouch with one hand and looks mildly bored.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
내 호의 돌려내, 사기꾼아!
다신 징기한테 양보 안 해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide side-angle punchline shot, cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Orc Warrior (she/her) holding her compact one-handed axe and sturdy shield stomps her foot with furious teary eyes, yelling at the departing paladin. On the right, Undead Paladin (she/her) with her two-handed warhammer strapped on her back calmly walks off-panel whistling while clutching her fat leather pouch of gold coins.
